rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE OF FRONTEND TEST BLOCKING: The Expo app uses @react-native-async-storage/async-storage on web, which is backed by IndexedDB and JSON-serialises values. Therefore the standard testing technique of localStorage.setItem('apex.session_token','sess_...') does not hydrate the AuthContext. Combined with the still-unfixed iteration-1 issue that the root index redirects to /login as soon as AuthContext.user is null (without first awaiting hydration), an automated test that bypasses onboarding via API can never reach the (tabs) screens. The mitigation is twofold and OWNED BY MAIN AGENT: (a) add testIDs to onboarding option cards so the script can complete the UI flow, and (b) make root-index guard wait for AuthContext.isHydrating to be false before redirecting. Independently confirmed: backend supplies everything correctly (28/28 pytest, including newly added tests for interval billing, retry/gating/memory, plan/week).
